mapper.select: select og.sys_id, og.order_num , ti.table_num , og.insert_datetime as order_datetime, om.order_status from order_group og left join order_master om on om.sys_id = og.link_sys_id left join table_info ti on ti.sys_id = om.link_sys_id

select od.link_sys_id3 as link_sys_id , 'MENU' as row_type , od.sys_id as detail_sys_id , null as parent_detail_sys_id , smd.menu_name as item_name , od.qty from order_detail od left join order_group og on og.sys_id = od.link_sys_id3 left join order_master om on om.sys_id = og.link_sys_id left join store_menu_detail smd on smd.sys_id = od.link_sys_id2 union all select od.link_sys_id3 as link_sys_id , 'OPTION' as row_type , odo.sys_id as detail_sys_id , odo.link_sys_id as parent_detail_sys_id , smod.menu_option_name as item_name , odo.qty from order_detail od left join order_group og on og.sys_id = od.link_sys_id3 left join order_master om on om.sys_id = og.link_sys_id left join order_detail_option odo on odo.link_sys_id = od.sys_id left join store_menu_option_detail smod on smod.sys_id = odo.link_sys_id2 where 1=1

select od.link_sys_id3 as sys_id , sum(smd.menu_price * od.qty + coalesce(opt_sum.option_price, 0)) as total_price from order_detail od left join order_group og on og.sys_id = od.link_sys_id3 left join order_master om on om.sys_id = og.link_sys_id left join store_menu_detail smd on smd.sys_id = od.link_sys_id2 left join ( select odo.link_sys_id , sum(smod.menu_option_price * odo.qty) as option_price from order_detail_option odo left join store_menu_option_detail smod on smod.sys_id = odo.link_sys_id2 group by odo.link_sys_id ) opt_sum on opt_sum.link_sys_id = od.sys_id where 1=1 group by od.link_sys_id3
